_note_source_classifications: Set peers.<name>.allowed_source_classifications to give one peer a narrower list than the other. See the Privacy choices section of README.md.
_note_ledger: The append-only ledger is never deleted by cleanup: it is the audit record. There is deliberately no ledger retention setting, because a number here would imply a rotation that does not happen.
_note_reasoning_effort: null means the CLI's own default. Neither peer inherits your personal setting: the Codex peer runs with --ignore-user-config and the Claude peer is invoked fresh. Set one of low, medium, high, xhigh, max per peer in config/local.json. Higher effort costs more and takes longer, and is usually worth it for review work.
_note_local_first: Consultation accountability (docs/LOCAL-FIRST-DESIGN.md section 2.8), off by default and a separate switch from the orchestration read gate's own local_first.enabled. Turning it on is the operator's decision: set enabled true and local_queue_root to the SAME local-queue directory the orchestration read gate uses (state_root/local-queue by default; must be an absolute path), so a claude_start/codex_start/*_continue call with a prompt at or above read_gate_min_bytes must then declare local_first. A digest_receipt_id only satisfies one call, and only within receipt_max_age_seconds of when it was minted -- both bound so one honestly-obtained receipt cannot cover every future consultation forever. This is accountability, not enforcement: the assistant can always satisfy it instead with a typed bypass reason. See agent-bridge-admin local-first.
